Yes. Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India, and takes on projects across the GCC, Europe and Africa with meetings in your business hours.

India combines a very large engineering talent pool with lower cost than the GCC, UK or Europe, plus a working-hour overlap of most of the day with the Gulf and Africa and a shared afternoon with Europe.
You do. Contracts assign all code and intellectual property to the client, and code is kept in your repository.

content.text: What can Ladder7 help us build?
Custom software, web applications and websites, mobile apps, AI assistants and automation, integrations between business systems, and the technology strategy behind them.
Do you work with smaller businesses?
Ladder7 works with startups and growing SMBs as well as established organisations. Start with a conversation about your goals and current priorities.
Where should we start with AI?
Start with a specific workflow or customer need. Explore where an assistant, chatbot, knowledge system or automated next action could make that work more useful.
Do you work with clients outside India?

Yes. Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India, and takes on projects across the GCC, Europe and Africa with meetings in your business hours.
Why outsource software development to India?

India combines a very large engineering talent pool with lower cost than the GCC, UK or Europe, plus a working-hour overlap of most of the day with the Gulf and Africa and a shared afternoon with Europe.
Who owns the code you build?
You do. Contracts assign all code and intellectual property to the client, and code is kept in your repository.
